outcome: Major cardiac malformation (hypoplastic left heart syndrome)
cohort: Fertile women under lithium treatment for bipolar disorder who called the Teratology Information Service at A. Gemelli University Hospital in Rome from May 2002 to December 2015.
finding: One major cardiac malformation (hypoplastic left heart syndrome) was reported among 34 patients with complete follow-up, along with instances of premature birth, spontaneous abortions, intrauterine growth retardation, and transient respiratory distress, emphasizing the critical importance of peri-conceptional counseling for women on lithium treatment.
